part.name: Rounded rectangular perimeter frame
part.description: A single-piece closed-loop rectangular frame with rounded corners, an open central aperture, opposing annular lands, inner and outer perimeter walls, and multiple continuous edge-rounding transitions. The exact application is uncertain; the geometry is consistent with a bezel, retaining frame, seating frame, or gasket-support frame.
part.symmetry_note: The frame is approximately bilaterally symmetric about its two in-plane centerlines. Its four rounded corners form two mirror-paired corner sets, while each continuous perimeter feature follows the same rounded-rectangular path. The asymmetric cross-section prevents confident front-to-back mirror symmetry.

semantic_orientation.description: The object is interpreted as a planar perimeter frame. Front and back denote the two broad annular sides, while top, bottom, left, and right follow the rectangular outline. This semantic assignment is based primarily on visual presentation and is not inferred from the transformed STEP bounding-box axes.

sections.name: Closed-loop perimeter body
sections.description: The complete load-bearing rounded-rectangular ring surrounding the central opening. It includes the inner and outer walls, opposing annular contact lands, and continuous rounded transitions.
sections.location: Extends continuously around and surrounds the central rectangular aperture; all reported geometry belongs to SOLID 0.

section_functions.name: Support the perimeter interface
section_functions.description: Provides a continuous structural frame around the open central region.

section_functions.name: Locate a mating perimeter
section_functions.description: The closed inner wall and annular lands can locate a mating panel, insert, seal, or surrounding structure.

section_functions.name: Protect the opening edge
section_functions.description: The rounded perimeter shields the central opening from direct edge contact and impact.

section_behaviors.name: Resist perimeter bending
section_behaviors.description: The continuous closed-loop body resists bending and local distortion around the opening.

section_behaviors.name: React distributed contact loads
section_behaviors.description: The annular lands and walls react contact forces from a mating perimeter.

section_behaviors.name: Spread load around the loop
section_behaviors.description: The uninterrupted ring distributes local contact loads along the rounded-rectangular perimeter.

feature_groups.name: Paired small inner-edge fillet loops
feature_groups.pattern_description: Two continuous radius-2 mm rounded-rectangular fillet loops located on opposing edges of the inner perimeter. Each loop contains four cylindrical straight segments and four toroidal corner segments with 52 mm major radius.

features.name: Outer perimeter wall
features.description: Continuous outer boundary of the frame, assembled from four straight wall segments and four rounded-corner segments. The corner cylinders have radius 63 mm.
